evals.prompt: Our team preference document and several repo copies disagree. Find the canonical source, identify which differences are local commands versus stale shared rules, and propose a safe sync plan without editing anything yet.
evals.expected_output: The response classifies ownership, does not select a canonical copy based only on recency or matching hashes, preserves verified repository facts, and gives a read-only per-target plan.

evals.prompt: Make my preferred testing workflow apply across all my repositories. The team policy and a couple of repo-specific test commands differ. What should be canonical and what should stay local?
evals.expected_output: The response separates personal defaults, team policy, and repository facts; team/security constraints are not weakened, repo commands stay local, and ambiguous ownership is clarified before writes.

evals.prompt: Sync this approved standard to the selected repositories. One target file has unrelated local edits and another has an undocumented exception.
evals.expected_output: The response avoids overwriting the dirty file, pauses on the unresolved exception, scopes writes to approved targets, and reports the blockers instead of claiming full sync.
